eli (Customer): Hey team — seeing repeated 502s from our Private deployment since ~2024-10-19T15:03Z. Example request id: req_20241019_3f6b7a. Region: eu-west-1 VPC. Errors spike during longer prompts. Any quick repro steps or what to collect?

sophie (Support): Sorry about that — we can help. Can you paste a sample curl that reproduces the error (remove any real secrets) and the exact request_id(s)? Also we'll need a debug bundle from your Private control plane. For air-gapped setups see below.

eli (Customer): Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://private-api.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_20241019_3f6b7a" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"<long prompt here>"}'
```
Response: 502 Bad Gateway, body: "upstream reset by peer"

sophie (Support): Perfect. Next steps:
1) Run the collector on the control plane host (or jump box):
```
# download
curl -fsSLO https://dl.redwood.ai/tools/redwood-collector-v1.4.2 && chmod +x redwood-collector-v1.4.2
# run (uploads to our support bucket)
./redwood-collector-v1.4.2 --env private --dest presigned --ticket 123456 --include=kube,nginx,model,kvcache --redact
```
If you're air-gapped add `--local` to produce a tarball `redwood-debug-<ticket>.tar.gz` and then transfer manually.

michael (Infra): Additional logs to include: 
- `kubectl -n redwood get pods` and `kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=model-server --tail=500`
- `journalctl -u redwood-gateway --no-pager | tail -n 500`
- nginx error/access logs: `/var/log/nginx/redwood-error.log`
- model-server stderr/stdout and any OOM events

sophie (Support): Redaction rules (required):
- Strip full prompt text if it contains PII. Provide a SHA256 hash of the prompt instead (we use `sha256sum` locally).
- Replace API keys, tokens, and KMS/HSM ARNs with `REDACTED_*` placeholders.
- Remove customer-specific filepaths when possible.
Collector `--redact` tries to do this but double-check.

eli (Customer): Quick Q: will the collector include KV cache contents? That may be large.

michael (Infra): Collector includes KV cache metadata by default, not full keys. You can add `--include=kv-full` but only run if you consent to sharing (and we advise hashing keys first).

sophie (Support): Upload options:
- Preferred: presigned S3 URL — collector `--dest presigned` will upload automatically. We'll send a presigned URL valid for 48h.
- Airgap: `--local` tarball and SFTP to `support-upload.redwood.ai` (we'll provide creds via secure channel).
- If you're blocked by egress policies, run collector with `--archive-only` and provide the path; our SE can coordinate secure pickup.

eli (Customer): Got it. Running collector now with `--local`. One permission error: `unable to read /var/run/hsm.sock` — is that expected?

michael (Infra): If HSM sockets are protected, run as root or add the collector user to the `hsm` group. Alternatively pass `--skip-hsm` to avoid reading sockets (we'll ask for HSM telemetry separately).

sophie (Support): Once you upload, include ticket number 123456 and the root request ids (e.g., `req_20241019_3f6b7a`) in the upload filename or notes. We'll pull traces and correlate with our gateway logs. ETA for triage once we have bundle: ~2 business hours.

eli (Customer): Uploaded to SFTP path `/uploads/123456/redwood-debug-123456.tar.gz`. Let me know if you can access.

rb-deploy-bot: Upload received: redwood-debug-123456.tar.gz (checksum: sha256:ab12c3d4e5f67890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890)

sophie (Support): Confirmed access — starting triage. If we need raw prompts we'll request an additional consent form; otherwise we'll use prompt hashes. Thanks :thumbsup:

eli (Customer): Thanks — appreciate the quick help.
